Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of TXN.
Operating income reached $11.4 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 17% to 10% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
We generated $4.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 17% to 10% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 119 basis points to 52.6%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 119 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
